answer_sentences.text: The sanction letter does impose a 2% pre-payment charge on the amount prepaid.
answer_sentences.quote: 2.2 Pre-payment charges: 2% of the amount prepaid.

answer_sentences.text: However, the provided RBI source only shows that the central bank issued the Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 in response to problematic and divergent MSE pre-payment-charge practices, and it does not include the operative rule text needed to confirm whether a 2% clause complies with the current requirements.
answer_sentences.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 ... Reserve Bank’s supervisory reviews have indicated divergent practices amongst Regulated Entities (REs) with regard to levy of pre-payment charges in case of loans sanctioned to MSEs which lead to customer grievances and disputes.
